verdict.summary: Blocked: layout validation can miss undeclared gitlinks, and trusted evidence does not establish the linked issue's required validation for head 4082e5a45fe42631d921decd7ddae4e359e60b0e.

blockingFindings.title: Index-only gitlinks evade fail-closed package classification
blockingFindings.details: The validator includes actual packages/ gitlinks in managedPackagePaths, but reports no error when an indexed gitlink has neither a .gitmodules declaration nor an active/parked inventory classification. An index-only stage-0 gitlink such as packages/rogue therefore passes this loop when its worktree directory is absent; gitlinks outside packages/ and data/ are ignored entirely. This fails the issue requirement that apps/ and plugins/ contain no managed gitlinks and that layout validation remain fail-closed. Validate every indexed gitlink, reject paths outside the allowed roots, and require each packages/ gitlink to be both declared and classified, with regression tests for index-only entries.

blockingFindings.title: Required acceptance and validation evidence is missing
blockingFindings.details: For repository marius-patrik/Andromeda PR #300 at head 4082e5a45fe42631d921decd7ddae4e359e60b0e, the trusted state verifies only the open target version. The PR body's claimed commands are untrusted and cannot prove success. No trusted results establish git diff --check, git submodule status --recursive, bun run ci, or successful fresh-clone recursive submodule initialization. The exact-head review must remain blocked until those results and gitlink revision evidence are verified.
